type: char 2-4gram + word TF-IDF, nearest-neighbour cosine, abstain on low similarity or small margin
split: train rules ('case', 'spacing', 'punct', 'typo', 'suffix'); held-out rules ('vowels', 'abbrev'); ~1/3 of aliases per test held out entirely; unknown names split dev/held-out; D* printed names in train; E* never used
